description: This file is a header file (.h) defining interfaces and external dependencies for a cryptographic module, including function declarations for cipher operations and context management.

methods.name: hexstr2buf
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a buffer, returning a pointer to the buffer and setting its length.

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Retrieves a cipher based on the provided name, or prints an error if not found.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the IV size for a given cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size for a given cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cipher context with specified parameters.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on input data using the provided context.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and cleans up the cipher context.
